annotations.title: Save a copy or switch file

description: Write the document to another file: mode copy (default) saves a copy (Kopie speichern) and the open document keeps its own file – the way to start the next issue from the current one; mode switch saves under the new name and the open document continues there (Speichern unter). template true writes an .indt. An existing file needs overwrite true. Returns path, bytes, overwritten, name and document_path of the open document afterwards. save_document is for saving in place. With managed stories (editorial workflow) both modes warn: the new file links to the same story files but is not bound to the editorial workflow.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file. Default false.

path.description: Target file path, ending in .indd or .indt, in an existing folder.

template.description: Write as template (.indt / stationery). Default false.
